about: Get a commercial economic licence for approved commercial, tourism, agricultural, artisanal or professional activities.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

fees: 10 AED economic register fee and 10 AED licence issuance fee
Chamber membership from 150 AED (craft) to 2,000 AED (professional); 1,650 AED for commercial, tourism, agriculture, livestock and fisheries
Companies also pay 50 AED notarisation, 1,500 AED social contribution and 2,500 AED Ministry of Economy fee
timing: Other entities may need to approve too
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
